simplebeacons.guide.page.1.title: Simple Beacons
simplebeacons.guide.page.1: The Strong Upgrade turns a beacon into a Strong Beacon with five pyramid levels and new powers, and a conduit into a Strong Conduit with a 7x7x7 frame.
simplebeacons.guide.page.2.title: Simple Beacons
simplebeacons.guide.page.2: The Mighty Beacon adds a sixth level; the Evil beacons weaken players instead.
simplebeacons.guide.page.3.title: Strong Upgrade
simplebeacons.guide.page.3: A smithing template you cannot craft from plain materials: it comes from the Wither.
simplebeacons.guide.page.4.title: Strong Upgrade
simplebeacons.guide.page.4: It turns a beacon into a Strong Beacon and a conduit into a Strong Conduit.
simplebeacons.guide.page.5.title: Evil Upgrade
simplebeacons.guide.page.5: A smithing template that turns a beacon into an Evil Beacon (with a nether star). With Simple Mobs:
simplebeacons.guide.page.6.title: Evil Upgrade
simplebeacons.guide.page.6: a Strong Upgrade, a crying obsidian, a Nether Heart and a Red Nether Jewel (shapeless) make one.
simplebeacons.guide.page.7.title: Strong Beacon
simplebeacons.guide.page.7: A beacon with up to five pyramid levels (11x11 below the Vanilla four, 285 blocks in all): primary powers on levels 1 to 4, the secondary power on level 5.
simplebeacons.guide.page.8.title: Strong Beacon
simplebeacons.guide.page.8: Range is (10 + 10 per level) x the material factor (60 blocks with Iron at level 5, at most 340 with every setting), the effect lasts 9 + 2 per level seconds; it affects players only, like Vanilla.
simplebeacons.guide.page.9.title: Mighty Beacon
simplebeacons.guide.page.9: The next step after the Strong Beacon: up to six pyramid levels (454 blocks), primary powers on levels 1 to 5, the secondary power on level 6, range 70 blocks with Iron at level 6.
simplebeacons.guide.page.10.title: Evil Beacon
simplebeacons.guide.page.10: A beacon that weakens instead of helping: mild negative powers for players in range (primary levels 1 to 4,
simplebeacons.guide.page.11.title: Evil Beacon
simplebeacons.guide.page.11: the secondary power on level 5), up to 5 pyramid levels like the Strong Beacon. Made of a beacon with the Evil Upgrade.
simplebeacons.guide.page.12.title: Mighty Evil Beacon
simplebeacons.guide.page.12: The Evil Beacon's big brother: up to six pyramid levels, primary powers on levels 1 to 5, the secondary power on level 6.
simplebeacons.guide.page.13.title: Mighty Evil Beacon
simplebeacons.guide.page.13: Same recipe as the Mighty Beacon with the Evil Beacon in the middle.
simplebeacons.guide.page.14.title: Beacon screen
simplebeacons.guide.page.14: The beacons open a beacon screen in Vanilla's own style: one row taller (Strong, Evil:
simplebeacons.guide.page.15.title: Beacon screen
simplebeacons.guide.page.15: four primary rows) or two rows taller (Mighty kinds: five rows), three powers per row; every pyramid level has its own marker icon.
simplebeacons.guide.page.16.title: Beacon screen
simplebeacons.guide.page.16: The pyramid counter (for example Pyramid 0/6), the material factor (for example Material ×1.25) and the current range and duration sit in the right field.
simplebeacons.guide.page.17.title: Range by pyramid material
simplebeacons.guide.page.17: The range of all Strong, Mighty, Evil and Vanilla beacons grows with the pyramid's material: Netherite blocks count x2, Diamond x1.5, Gold and Emerald x1.1, Iron x1.
simplebeacons.guide.page.18.title: Range by pyramid material
simplebeacons.guide.page.18: The factor is the average over all blocks of the counted levels.
simplebeacons.guide.page.19.title: Upgrading a placed beacon or conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.19: Hold an axe (with a hammer mod such as Simple Hammers:
simplebeacons.guide.page.20.title: Upgrading a placed beacon or conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.20: its sledgehammer) in the main hand and the Strong Upgrade in the off hand,
simplebeacons.guide.page.21.title: Upgrading a placed beacon or conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.21: carry a nether star and use a placed beacon or conduit 8 times.
simplebeacons.guide.page.22.title: Strong Conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.22: A conduit with a larger area (owner: no new ability):
simplebeacons.guide.page.23.title: Strong Conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.23: range is (frame blocks / 7) x 24, 1.5 times Vanilla's 16 - 144 blocks with the Vanilla 5x5x5 frame,
simplebeacons.guide.page.24.title: Strong Conduit
simplebeacons.guide.page.24: 216 with the full 7x7x7 frame (three crossing 7x7 rings of prismarine, prismarine bricks, dark prismarine or sea lanterns, 66 blocks).
simplebeacons.guide.page.25.title: Creative tabs
simplebeacons.guide.page.25: The module's items sit in its own creative tab and are also sorted into the fitting Vanilla tabs and the search tab.
simplebeacons.guide.page.26.title: Commands
simplebeacons.guide.page.26: /simplebeacons config shows and changes every option of config/simplebeacons-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simplebeacons.guide.page.27.title: Commands
simplebeacons.guide.page.27: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once; options read only at start say so. Permission level 2.
simplebeacons.guide.page.28.title: Settings
simplebeacons.guide.page.28: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
